text: s Hospital，Wuhan，Hubei，China 430060;2． Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine，Chengdu，Sichuan，China 611137;3． Chongqing Healn Pharmaceutical Co． ，Ltd． ，Chongqing，China 401121)Abstract: Objective To explore the curative effect of Jinchan Relieving Itch Capsule on mice skin itch． Methods 2'4 toluene diisocyanate ( TDI) ，dextran( DX) and 4 － aminopyridine were selected for causing the skin itch symptom in mice respectively． The model mice were treated by Jinchan Relieving Itch Capsule and the mice manifestations were observed for deducing the curative effects of drugs． Results All doses groups of Jinchan Relieving Itch Capsule obviously prolonged the incubative stage of itch induced by TDI and 4 － aminopyridine( $P < 0 . 0 5 )$ and reduce the scratch times significantly during the itch process induced by TDI( $P < 0 . 0 1 )$ ;
